title: Spiked Spear Tips + Better Diminishing Tools Compatibility Pack
description: This is a project that make Spiked Spear Tips and Better Diminishing Tools compatible!
body:
This pack makes Better Diminishing Tools compatible with Spiked Spear Tips

Format:
Compat Pack
Spiked Spear Tips
Better Diminishing Tools

If you use both Better Diminishing Tools and Spiked Spear Tips, you've probably noticed that they don't always work perfectly together. That's exactly why I made this compatibility pack. It combines the two packs in a way that lets you enjoy the features of both without worrying about broken models, missing textures, or visual conflicts.

The pack keeps the unique look of the Spiked Spear Tips models while making sure they properly support the durability-based visuals from Better Diminishing Tools. As your tools wear down, you'll still be able to see the diminishing effects, all while keeping the detailed spear tip designs that make the original pack stand out.

I wanted the integration to feel as natural as possible, so the models and textures have been adjusted to match the style of both packs. The result is a cleaner and more polished experience that feels like the two packs were designed to work together from the start.

Whether you're exploring caves, fighting mobs, or working on a big building project, this compatibility pack helps everything look and function the way it should. Just place it above the original packs in your resource pack list, and you're ready to go. It's a simple addition, but it makes a big difference for players who want the best of both packs.
